name: EmbeddingGather8x4
adaptation: Table T has eight rows of four eight-bit elements, flattened index 4*r+c. Four unsigned three-bit indices are packed at 3*i. Output has four rows: Y[i,c]=T[index[i],c], packed at 8*(4*i+c). Preserve request order and duplicates; every index 0..7 is legal. Table is supplied per transaction.
